suites.purpose: Native parsing, extraction, session mutations, input bounds and plugin recovery
Eight renderer specimens, exact native stream burst content and remount completion
Public empty-host image policy, inline PNG decoding and committed stream session isolation

features.transport: Native parser AST contains document, heading, list, table and math nodes plus the task text.
Native extraction and flattened native AST agree on exact plain text.
Native session append, replace and reset return the expected complete strings.
Two native parse results retain their separate before/after content.
The public input-size boundary rejects the oversized input with the declared error code.
Forty native parse results each contain their own iteration marker; elapsed time is informational.
The public renderer checks exact plugin order, transformed output, named error reporting and continuation after an intentional plugin failure.
Eight distinct specimen parse-completion callbacks are required.
features.claimLimit: This counts parse completion; the flow's content assertions and separate visual acceptance cover rendered appearance.

features.transport: All 24 appended token strings are read back exactly from the native session; the flow then observes the first and last rendered tokens.
The remount generation advances before the flow requires all eight parse callbacks again.
features.claimLimit: Generation is a lifecycle assertion, not a timing or visual-quality claim.

features.transport: The installed app opens its E2E route through the declared deep link.
The public Markdown image renderer blocks an inline PNG with an explicit empty host allowlist. The same PNG must load in the positive control.
With allowedHosts omitted and the data protocol explicitly allowed, native Image decodes the inline PNG and reveals its loaded-only title; its error alt is different.
A layout-effect observer latches any old-session text or AST committed after selecting B; the flow requires B's actual rendered marker.
After another write to old A, active B must receive its new text and AST without any stale commit.

pending.reason: The default image fixture uses an explicitly allowed data URI, so it does not observe HTTP requests or redirects.
prerequisites: A controlled HTTP(S) image server with request logs
A dedicated installed native QA target
pending.acceptance: Verify allowed host image bytes load and URLs denied by a nonempty or empty host list issue no request. Capture controlled server request evidence separately from fallback text.

pending.reason: Text and parse callbacks do not prove glyph layout, screen-reader speech, table dimensions or math drawing.
prerequisites: Authorized iOS and Android device runs
Representative text scaling and screen-reader settings
pending.acceptance: Inspect screenshots and accessibility output for math, code, tables, custom fonts, long-document virtualization and mixed scripts on both platforms.

pending.reason: Bounded content assertions and printed milliseconds are not frame-time or memory benchmarks.
prerequisites: A release build on a representative physical target
A recorded profiling workload and baseline
pending.acceptance: Measure sustained streaming frames, JS responsiveness and memory separately; do not infer performance from replay completion.
